title: Valkyries Win and Celebrate With a Parade
summary: The Golden State Valkyries are the new WNBA champions, and they celebrated in style on Wednesday. The players held a parade with fans in Oakland and San Francisco. They joked that fans should take the day off to join the party. The team's mascot is a raven named Vi, short for Violet. The celebration started at Jack London Square in Oakland. Then they took a ferry across the bay and paraded to near Oracle Park, home of the San Francisco Giants. Fans wore team colours and cheered from the street and even from a rooftop. The Valkyries are a new team. They were given a team only three years ago. Owner Joe Lacob said they would win a title in five years. They did it in two. In the finals, Atlanta player Angel Reese made a "too small" hand gesture at the Valkyries. The Valkyries turned it into a joke, and guard Juste Jocyte flashed the gesture to the fans at the parade.
why_it_matters: If your team wins, you can join a parade and cheer with your friends, just like the Valkyries' fans did.
